config.biolint.mode: Hybrid mode: local offline engine vs enterprise cloud sync.
config.biolint.synthFlowStudioUrl: SynthFlow Studio visual design URL (bridge for visual phases).
config.biolint.gc.warnLow: GC% below this triggers thermodynamic warning.
config.biolint.gc.warnHigh: GC% above this triggers thermodynamic warning.
config.biolint.minPrimerLength: Minimum DNA token length to lint inside generic files (py/ts/yaml).
config.biolint.minOrfLength: Minimum ORF length (nt) to report as valid ORF in visualizer.
config.biolint.enableHover: Show thermodynamic hover (Tm, GC%, ΔG) on DNA selections.
config.biolint.enableLocalThreatDb: Screen against local .bioguard/ public threat lists (offline).
config.biolint.debounceMs: Debounce delay (ms) before re-linting after edits.
config.biolint.tm.primerConcNM: Primer strand concentration (nM) for SantaLucia Tm.
config.biolint.tm.naConcMM: Monovalent salt Na+ (mM) for SantaLucia Tm salt correction.
config.biolint.codonHost: Expression host for codon optimality (CAI) checks.
config.biolint.codon.caiWarnBelow: Complete ORFs with CAI below this get an optimization hint.
config.biolint.codon.customTablePath: Optional JSON codon table {codon: freqPerThousand} overriding built-ins.
config.biolint.pair.maxDeltaTm: Primer-pair QC fails when |Tm_fwd − Tm_rev| exceeds this (°C).
config.biolint.enableInlayHints: Show inline Tm · GC% hints after DNA runs.
config.biolint.debug: Log per-file lint timings and verdicts to the BioLint output channel.
